leads.summary: Tray popup text inherits the pill's contrast color instead of its popup surface's color
leads.consequence: With pills on, an opaque light pill, light bar text and dark theme/popups background, the pill picker chooses dark text for the bar; opening the tray management popup or a tray application's menu then draws dark text on the independent dark PopupCard background. The symbolic icons on the pill improve, but labels, menu items, buttons and separators in the tray's popups become hard to read. Keep the pill-aware color for the on-bar symbolic icons and keep popup text tied to Color.popups.text or an appropriate popup foreground.
leads.triage: already_in_opus; Same as N1; corroboration. Coordinator spot-checked source.

leads.summary: Contrast picker assumes the drawn bar background is opaque, although background-alpha allows translucent bars
leads.consequence: On a drawn bar with pills enabled and [bar] background-alpha below 1, the actual bar and pill composite over the wallpaper, but pillForeground blends over the opaque RGB of background and pillTextSampled is false. For example a light wallpaper, dark #101010 background at 0.1 alpha, white bar text, no explicit pill: the computed backdrop is dark and white is selected, whereas the visible bar and the 10%-white raised pill are nearly light, so white text has poor contrast. Sample the wallpaper when the bar background is translucent, or use an opaque contrast-safe rule for that case.
leads.triage: behavioural_sent_to_opus; not published: narrow opt-in limitation, pre-existing since R1 head, unchanged by amendment

leads.summary: Large documented pill-inset settings can produce non-positive rectangle thickness
leads.consequence: The token reader accepts every nonnegative integer without an upper bound; with a default 26px horizontal bar, [bar] pill-inset = 13 gives height 0 and 14 gives height -2, while visible remains true. On vertical bars, [bar] pill-inset = 14 on the default 28px width similarly gives width 0. What the QML scene renders for a negative Rectangle is not confirmed without a GUI; zero thickness cannot fill a pill. Clamp to half the bar thickness or reject the out-of-range value.
leads.triage: factual_verified_by_coordinator; not published: out-of-range theme value, unchanged since R1

leads.summary: Alternative open PR #7251 rewrites the same section anchors and adds a second independent pill background
leads.consequence: If #7251's SectionPill wrappers are retained around this PR's ModuleLists on a future integration, the wrapper's hard-coded Style.space(8) end margins replace the pillRun.startMargin/endMargin needed for this PR's 2px inset at default values. If both sets of theme pill keys are enabled, the wrappers also paint their own full-section rectangle below this PR's per-run rectangles, yielding two capsule layers rather than one. Resolve the section-anchor conflict by choosing one geometry model or explicitly reconciling end margins and the two independent color layers; neither concurrent branch can be mechanically kept verbatim.
leads.triage: factual_conflict_with_alternative_pr; not published: #7251 is an alternative implementation; maintainers choose

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13139#issuecomment-5824083254) and the [author's reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13139#issuecomment-5829005486), checked at head `dbf89bf`.

**Verified:** the anchor, section-end margin and documentation fixes work as described. The drag z-order is unchanged, as the reply says it would be. The tray colour fix has one side effect: the tray's popup menus now take the pill text colour too (new finding below).

| Earlier finding | At `dbf89bf` |
|---|---|
| Pills off: anchored centre widget moves 1 px | **Resolved.** `BarModel.anchorOffset` computes `round(P/2) - round(s/2)`, which is how `anchors.centerIn` rounds in Qt's `qquickanchors.cpp` (identical in 6.10.3, 6.11.2 and 6.12.0-rc1). It matches a `qRound` model on about 2.77 M size pairs, fractional sizes included (1080/81 now gives 499, as Qt does). With pills on, the widget content stays on the same pixel for every role. |
| `"pill": false` widgets and tray icons colour | **Resolved as scoped.** The tray's bar icons follow the pill text colour. Bare widgets keep the pill text colour, now documented in `docs/omarchy-shell.md` and the bar README. |
| Bare widget at a section end overhangs the bar | **Resolved.** A bare outer widget sits 8 px from the bar end again, and an outer pill still sits `pill-inset` from it (also with an odd `pill-gap` and with `pill-inset = 0`). |
| Dragging a pill's first widget covers the rest | **Still present**, deliberately deferred. `Bar.qml` still gives the dragged slot `z: 100` while it draws the run's pill. |
| `omarchy bar pills` reference, layer-rules 404 | **Resolved.** The reference is gone, and the new wiki link resolves and documents the same `hl.layer_rule` syntax as the snippet. |

### With pills on, the tray's popup menus use the pill text colour

`shell/plugins/bar/widgets/Tray.qml:21` changes the tray's whole `foreground` property to the pill-aware colour. That property colours the bar icons (line 796), and also both tray popups:

- the tray-management popup: header, item names, Pin/Hide buttons (lines 416-506);
- a tray item's right-click menu: border, row text, hover fills, check mark, submenu glyph (lines 537-738).

Both popups are `PopupCard`s drawn on `Color.popups.background` (`shell/Ui/PopupCard.qml:153`), not on a pill. The other bar panels colour their popup content with `bar.foreground`, and the tray did too at the previous head.

```text
pill text picker ─┬─ bar text               (usual case)
                  └─ Color.background       (light pill on a dark theme, and similar)
                                │
Tray.foreground ────────────────┤── bar icons         on the pill    OK
                                └── popup text/border on the popup card
                                                      = [popups] background = {{ background }}
```

Computed with the head's colour helpers:

| Theme and pill setup | Tray popup text | Popup card | Contrast (theme text before) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tokyo Night, `"pills": "section"` only | `#a9b1d6` | `#1a1b26` | 8.1 (8.1) |
| Tokyo Night, `[bar] pill = "{{ foreground }}"` | `#1a1b26` | `#1a1b26` | 1.0 (8.1) |
| Tokyo Night, `[bar] pill-text = "{{ background }}"` | `#1a1b26` | `#1a1b26` | 1.0 (8.1) |
| Catppuccin Latte, `[bar] pill = "{{ foreground }}"` | `#eff1f5` | `#eff1f5` | 1.0 (7.06) |

The same flip can come from a translucent pill on a transparent bar over a light wallpaper. In a sandbox run with Tokyo Night colours and a light test image, the head's `omarchy-bar-text-color` with `--blend '#1a1b26' 0.5` returned `#1a1b26`; at the template's example alpha 0.85 it did not flip.

**Impact:** with pills on and a pill colour of the opposite lightness, a flipping translucent pill, or a `pill-text` close to the popup background, the tray's right-click menu and management popup become unreadable (with the stock popup colours, the text is exactly the popup background colour). Stock themes with only `"pills": "section"` are not affected. This comes from source and computed colours; it was not observed on screen.

**Suggested change:** keep `foreground` on `bar.foreground` for popup content, and give only the bar-facing tray icons the pill-aware colour, for example:

```qml
readonly property color foreground: bar ? bar.foreground : Color.foreground
readonly property color barIconColor: bar ? (bar.pillsOn ? bar.barForeground : bar.foreground) : Color.foreground
// TrayIcon colorizes with a `tint` property defaulting to root.foreground;
// the TrayItem on the bar sets tint: root.barIconColor.
```

No test covers the tray colour in either direction.

**Verified:** on this head, `bar-test.sh` (128 checks) and `bar-text-color-test.sh` (8 checks) pass. On the merge-base, the same tests fail at the `icon-slot` token and the first `--blend` case. The rewritten numeric-key test in the first commit runs the real `Style.qml` parser rather than matching its text. With pills off, colours, margins, slot geometry, the sampler arguments and the tray colour are the same as the base in source.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** source review of head `dbf89bf` against the previously reviewed `2b60e70` and the merge-base `28ceaae`, including Qt's `qquickanchors.cpp` and the Hyprland layer-rules wiki page. The PR's tests and extra anchor, margin and colour cases ran in an isolated sandbox (the JS cases under Node), with the merge-base as a negative control. Nothing was rendered: the author's "0 differing pixels" result was not re-checked, and the popup contrast above is computed, not observed.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
